correctness.rationale: A support-preserving graph-product presentation and retractions to the free product of two one-idempotent-generator monoids classify idempotents and give explicit centralizer inclusion witnesses. The pointwise centralizer-intersection lemma is proved by comparing two-letter projections and moving first/last occurrences of a generator. For clique idempotents, strict inclusion iff the extra generators are universal, so the unordered centralizer poset is the opposite clique-face poset of the graph with universal vertices deleted. The center is exactly the Boolean monoid on universal vertices. Thus the poset and center cardinality reconstruct the entire graph; empty and complete cases are included. Replaying the actual package verify.py checked all 75 graphs on <=4 vertices and 10971 normal forms, not an infinite proof.

The new claim is the inverse reconstruction with an exact universal-vertex ambiguity, proved independently here. The full general paper could nonetheless contain the same inverse theorem and this risk is retained.

originality.rationale: This is an inverse reconstruction claim for an intrinsic unlabelled poset, not a claim of first discovering graph-product centralizers. Yang and Li (2022/23) already compute centralizers in general graph products of semigroups; their general centralizer formula therefore covers the auxiliary centralizer decomposition. Yang–Gould (2021/23) and Alqahtani–Yang–Gould (2021) provide monoid and semigroup normal forms. The directly searched source statements and accessible primary full texts do not assert reconstruction from the poset plus center. A full-text overlap check against the relevant Yang–Li general centralizer paper remains unavailable and is a material residual risk; no exhaustive priority certification is claimed.
residual_risks: Yang–Li 2022/23 explicitly studies all centralizers of semigroup graph products; its complete article was not accessible and may contain the proposed reconstruction or a stronger theorem from which it follows with little additional work. General centralizer descriptions are therefore not claimed as novel.
Semantic and web searches cannot rule out less-indexed exact statements under alternative terminology; independent literature priority review remains necessary.
The center cardinality is an essential separate datum; without it the stated reconstruction fails on cones.

value.rationale: A natural intrinsic semigroup invariant—the unlabelled inclusion order of centralizers of idempotents—recovers the clique complex of the defining graph up to a sharp and explicitly resolved universal-vertex ambiguity. Combining this order with the size of the center gives an isomorphism classifier for an infinite family of often infinite monoids, rather than a small numerical increment or arbitrary slice. The proof includes explicit strict-inclusion witnesses and explains exactly why center size is indispensable.
